data.message:
Balance patch: Vertical missile launchers + misc (#9415)

Starburst launchers (vertical missile launchers) stats (turnrate,
weaponacceleration, weapontimer, weaponvelocity, cruise_chase_factor)
have been adjusted to better fit the new tech. Fixes dead zones and
inaccurate targeting hopefully in all scenarios.
Overall the missiles are slightly faster, ~10% less time to reach a
target at max range, but this is not strictly uniform across all units.

Edgeeffectiveness (damage falloff rate) and impulse have been
standardised for these weapons, (tac)nukes at 0 EE, 1.1 impulse, EMP
missiles at 1EE, everything else at 0.5EE and 1 impulsefactor. Other
stats slightly adjusted to compensate where needed.

Missile hovercraft received a pure buff
Vehicle missile launchers got higher energy cost and buffed weapons.
Shiva got a nerf overall, but the Gantry itself was made cheaper to
compensate (now closer to Armada Gantry in price)
Tiger got nerfed, as it's a bit too efficient on open maps, even
unmicroed. Its weapon gets less accurate and slower to fire.
Shuriken gets small speed nerf, to bring its powerlevel more in line
with other air units.

Missile hovers:
- EE 0.15 -> 0.5
- Impulsefactor 1
